Message: /* select#1 */ select `ep2_lab`.`s`.`store_id` AS `store_id`,`ep2_lab`.`s`.`store_name` AS `store_name`,count(`ep2_lab`.`o`.`order_id`) AS `pedidos`,coalesce(sum(`ep2_lab`.`o`.`total_amount`),0) AS `valor_pedidos` from `ep2_lab`.`ep2_stores` `s` left join `ep2_lab`.`ep2_orders` `o` on(((`ep2_lab`.`o`.`store_id` = `ep2_lab`.`s`.`store_id`) and (cast(`ep2_lab`.`o`.`order_ts` as date) >= <cache>(cast((@`long_start_ts`) as date))) and (cast(`ep2_lab`.`o`.`order_ts` as date) < <cache>(cast((@`end_ts`) as date))) and (`ep2_lab`.`o`.`status` <> 'CANCELLED'))) where (`ep2_lab`.`s`.`region` = <cache>((@`region`))) group by `ep2_lab`.`s`.`store_id`,`ep2_lab`.`s`.`store_name` order by `valor_pedidos` desc,`ep2_lab`.`s`.`store_id`
